title: Warranty Claim Authorization Form
subtitle: Automotive Warranty Claim: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Warranty Claim Authorization Form turns vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file into a customer-facing Automotive Warranty Claim consent record. The warranty claim coordinator itemizes diagnostics or services, labor, parts or materials, fees, tax, estimated total, maximum cap, and the customer / warranty payer's signed decision. Work not listed or priced remains on hold.
use_case: Use Warranty Claim Authorization Form at service facility, diagnostic bay, records system, and retained-parts area. Verify applicable Automotive Warranty Claim requirements; distinguish diagnostic or inspection authority from listed work, price each operation, and record the customer / warranty payer's exact approval, conditions, or decline. Follow the selected contact-before-additional-work instruction whenever vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file scope or cost changes.
